title: SendGrid near-misses: must not be flagged (tool-corroborated)
summary: Values with a shortened segment, a missing separator, the wrong prefix or only masks and prose. Covers 6 inputs.
rationale: A near-miss is not an issued key. These prove that structure, not the `SG.` prefix, decides the outcome.

expectation.rationale: Malformed-by-construction control: prefix-only, truncated, mis-delimited or public-material shape of a contracted family. Expected silence follows from construction.
